title: ProjectDefaults
description:
Project-wide defaults, `.chug/jobs/_defaults.yaml` (spec §1.1, §12.4). The `eval`
list is appended to every job type's evaluators — how a project gates all
changes on an evergreen suite without per-job-type declarations. `model`
sets a project-level default agent model layered between the platform
default and job-type declarations (spec §12.4).

model.description:
Project-level default agent model (spec §12.4). Applied to the work
agent and agent evaluators that do not declare their own `model`.

AgentTool.description:
A tool a job type may grant an agent on top of its role profile (design #533
S1). A **closed** set rather than an open string list, so `Bash`, `Edit` and
`Write` stay the role's — spec §4.3 has why.

oneOf.description:
Spawn subagents. They inherit the run's settings file, so a `Review`
child stays read-only: this widens effort, never capability.

Drive a deterministic multi-agent workflow, which is `Task` with a script
around it and the same inheritance.

image.description: command/agent: optional, falls back to top-level image; one of the two required.

secret_files.description:
Secrets this evaluator's container receives as **files** instead
(design #529 S3), under the same scoping rule as `secrets:` and
disallowed for a human evaluator (no container).

stage.description:
Staged evaluation ordering (spec §3.3): evaluators run in ascending
`stage` order; within a stage they fan out in parallel. A later stage's
tasks are created only after every *required* evaluator in the prior
stage passes. Default 0 — a single-stage job is byte-for-byte the
unstaged behavior. Non-negative (`u32`, enforced at parse).

tools.description:
Extra agent tools this evaluator may use, added to the `Review` profile
(spec §4.3). Not inherited from `work.tools`, and disallowed for a
command or human evaluator, which run no agent.

workload_identities.description:
Cloud identities (design #313 A5) this evaluator's container may
exchange a workload token for. The only container they reach; not
inherited from `work.workload_identities`, and disallowed for a human
evaluator (no container).
